description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between Mr. K. Piyarathne Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board (S & E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters as it contains an official order under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131) appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute. It references specific legislative enactments and amendments, making it a statutory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
